title: Turn Your GitHub Contribution Graph Into an ASCII City
why_read: A similar lighthearted contribution-graph visualization project, this time rendering an ASCII city skyline, more a fun hack than a technical deep dive.
analysis: Skyline is a small Go command-line tool that converts a GitHub contribution history into an ASCII-art city skyline, with buildings representing weeks and windows representing days, including an animated SVG version for profile READMEs. It's a neat demonstration of mapping tabular activity data to a visual metaphor and generating both terminal and SVG output from the same data. The technical content is lightweight, mostly about simple data-to-visual mapping and GitHub profile tricks, appealing more as a fun personal project than a substantive engineering piece.
